title: Debating Ethical Dilemmas / Debate game da matsaloli na dabi'a
bridge: A cikin Hausa, don yin nishadi muna yin amfani da yau da kullum da yaushe bayan bayanin ra'ayi. A cikin turanci, an yi amfani da subjunctive mai yawa; an fi son bayanin da ke da wata modal ko tsarin. Misali, 'ba zan yarda ba cewa yana da lafiya' yana da wata ma'ana kamar 'I don't think it is right' (ba 'it be right'). Kuma, yin amfani da 'should' da 'would' don shawara da yin kalubale ba da wata daidaitaccu a cikin Hausa, inda muna yin amfani da kalubale mai sauke. Duba cikin matsayi na adadin adadin da adadin ba da adadin ba a turanci.
rule: Don yin nishadi a turanci da mataki B2, yi amfani da: 1) 'I think/ believe/ feel' + tsarin da ke da wata daidaitaccu: 'I think that...' (ba subjunctive ba). 2) Modals: 'should' (shawara), 'ought to' (na da fasaha), 'must' (matsakaici mai tsanin yawa), 'can't' (rashin iya), 'could' (za a iya), 'would' (kalubale). 3) Tsarin da ke da wata daidaitaccu/rasa daidaitaccu: 'I agree with... because...', 'I see your point, but...', 'That may be true, however...'. 4) Kalubale don nishadi na kalubale: 'If we allowed... , then...' (farkon kalubale), 'If I were in that situation, I would...' (biyu na kalubale). 5) Tsarin da ke da wata daidaitaccu: 'therefore', 'moreover', 'nevertheless', 'although'. Kada ka yi amfani da rashin daidaitaccu daidai ('I don't agree with nothing' ba daidai ba) kuma yi amfani da inversion don yin ƙarfi: 'Not only is it unethical, but also...'.

concept_examples.text: I believe that animal testing is unethical because it causes unnecessary suffering.
concept_examples.translation: Ina tunawa cewa binciken da ke da jiki na yawa ba da lafiya saboda yana nuna wahalar da ba ake bukata ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈænɪməl ˈtestɪŋ ɪz ʌnˈeθɪkəl bɪˈkɔːz ɪt ˈkɔːzɪz ʌnˈnesəseri ˈsʌfərɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: If I were in that situation, I would tell the truth, even if it was difficult.
concept_examples.translation: Idan zan zama a wannan yanayi, zan yi adalci, ko da yaushe ya zama mai wahala.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ɪn ðæt ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən, aɪ wʊd tɛl ðə truːθ, ˈiːvən ɪf ɪt wʌz ˈdɪfɪkəlt/

concept_examples.text: Some people argue that genetically modified crops are necessary to feed the world, but others disagree.
concept_examples.translation: Wani mutane sun yarda cewa nishadi na fasaha da ke da saboda ya dace da cewa ake bukata, amma wata daya ba su yarda ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt dʒəˈnetɪkli ˈmɒdɪfaɪd krɒps ɑːr ˈnesəseri tuː fiːd ðə wɜːrld, bʌt ˈʌðərz ˌdɪsəˈɡriː/

concept_examples.text: We shouldn't sacrifice privacy for security; both are essential.
concept_examples.translation: Ba zan sake bukatunmu saboda tsaro ba; duk biyu na matsakaici.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈʃʊdnt ˈsækrɪfaɪs ˈpraɪvəsi fɔːr sɪˈkjʊrəti; boʊθ ɑːr ɪˈsenʃəl/

common_error.wrong: I don't think that it is not ethical to lie.
common_error.correct: I don't think it is ethical to lie.
common_error.correct_alt: I think it is unethical to lie.
common_error.explanation: An yi wata kuskure saboda a cikin Hausa muna yin amfani da rashin daidaitaccu daidai ('Ba zan yarda ba cewa ba da lafiya ba'), amma a turanci wata kalma mai daidaitaccu kawai ce a cikin jumla. Don sake gyara, kashe wata 'not' mai daidaitaccu ko canza da wata kalma da matsakaici (na fasaha).

examples.original: In my opinion, we should recycle more.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, wiː ʃʊd ˌriːˈsaɪkəl mɔːr/
examples.translation: A cikin ra'ayina, ya kamata mu yi watsi da wasanni da yawa.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'in my opinion' a farkon don yin ƙarfi da ra'ayinka.

examples.original: I strongly believe that every child deserves a quality education.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈɛvri tʃaɪld dɪˈzɜːrvz ə ˈkwɒləti ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Ina da ƙarfi cewa duk wani yaro ya dace da ilimi mai kwaliti.
examples.note: Adadin 'strongly' ya zo kafin 'believe'.

examples.original: From my perspective, this policy has more benefits than drawbacks.
examples.phonetic: /frɒm maɪ pərˈspɛktɪv, ðɪs ˈpɒləsi hæz mɔːr ˈbɛnɪfɪts ðæn ˈdrɔːbæks/
examples.translation: Daga cikin ra'ayina, wannan tsarin yana da fa'idodi da yawa da rashin wahala.
examples.note: Kada ka canza da 'Baya da cikin ra'ayina'.

examples.original: I couldn't agree more with your argument about renewable energy.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkʊdnt əˈɡriː mɔːr wɪð jɔːr ˈɑːrɡjumənt əˈbaʊt rɪˈnjuːəbl ˈɛnərdʒi/
examples.translation: Ba zan yarda da yarda ba da ra'ayinka game da fasaha mai saboda.
examples.note: Wannan tsarin yana nufin yarda da yawa. kada ka yi shi da 'I can't agree' (ba zan yarda ba).

examples.original: I see your point, but I think there are other factors to consider.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ siː jɔːr pɔɪnt, bʌt aɪ θɪŋk ðeər ɑːr ˈʌðər ˈfæktərz tuː kənˈsɪdər/
examples.translation: Na gane ra'ayinka, amma ina tunawa cewa akwai wasu abubuwa da suka dace da bincike.
examples.note: Tsarin da ke da rashin yarda ba tare da yin wahala.

examples.original: That may be true, however, we must also think about the long-term effects.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt meɪ biː truː, haʊˈɛvər, wiː mʌst ˈɔːlsoʊ θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈlɔːŋtɜːrm ɪˈfɛkts/
examples.translation: Wannan zai iya zama daidai, amma duk da haka muna bukata mu tuna da tasiri a kwanaki da yawa.
examples.note: Yin amfani da 'however' bayan tsari da koma.

levels.label: Proposing Hypothetical Situations
levels.translation: Ba da wani yanayi mai kalubale

examples.original: If the government banned all private cars, the air quality would improve significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt bænd ɔːl ˈpraɪvɪt kɑːrz, ðiː ɛər ˈkwɒləti wʊd ɪmˈpruːv sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Idan gwamnati ta tsare duk motoci na jama'a, na iya sabunta lafiya ta hanyar hanyar iyawa.
examples.note: Biyu na kalubale don yanayi da ba daidai ba ko yanayi mai kalubale. A turanci, yi amfani da 'were' a matsayin 'was' a kalubale.

examples.original: If I were the CEO, I would prioritize employee well-being over profits.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ðə ˌsiː.iːˈoʊ, aɪ wʊd praɪˈɔːrɪtaɪz ˌɛmplɔɪˈiː ˌwɛlˈbiːɪŋ ˈoʊvər ˈprɒfɪts/
examples.translation: Idan zan zama mai shugaba, zan nuna matsakaicin masu aiki da yawa saboda fasaha.
examples.note: Yin amfani da 'were' a kalubale mai yaushe. Yau da kullum, masu yin Hausa suna yi da 'I was'.

examples.original: What would you do if you found a wallet with a thousand dollars inside?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd juː duː ɪf juː faʊnd ə ˈwɔːlɪt wɪð ə ˈθaʊzənd ˈdɒlərz ɪnˈsaɪd?/
examples.translation: Me za ka yi idan ka samu jakar da kuɗin dubu biyu a cikin?
examples.note: Tsarin tambaya a kalubale: yi amfani da 'would' a farkon.

examples.original: If we don't act now, future generations will suffer the consequences.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt ækt naʊ, ˈfjuːtʃər ˌdʒɛnəˈreɪʃənz wɪl ˈsʌfər ðə ˈkɒnsɪkwɛnsɪz/
examples.translation: Idan ba muyi aiki yanzu, watan nan da nan, masu nan gaba suna iya samun fasara.
examples.note: Farkon kalubale don yanayi da ke da matsakaici da koyaushe.

title: Strategic Language for Negotiations / Tsarin fasaha na nishadi
bridge: A cikin wata, muna yin amfani da tsagin wasanni don zama mai zurfai ('na yiwu', 'na son') saboda haka a turanci ana yin amfani da wasanni kamar 'would', 'could' da 'might' don samun wannan tasiri, amma da tsarin farko. Wadanda suka yi magana da turanci suna da zurfai sosai yayin komawa da wata ba da izini, saboda haka a turanci ana tsammanin 'no' mai zurfai da kalmomin kamar 'I'm afraid' ko 'unfortunately'. Yi kuskure ba tare da fasalin 'de acuerdo' a turanci kamar 'I am agree' - da yaushe a turanci 'agree' yana da wata ma'ana ko 'yarda' ba tare da 'be'.
rule: A nishadi da turanci a tsaye B2, ana yin amfani da wasanni don nuna zurfai da fasaha (would, could, might, may). Tsarin kamar 'I would suggest...' ko 'We could consider...' ya fi 'I want...' ko 'You must...'. Don yin nishadi, ana yin amfani da 'What if...' ko 'How about...' da sauran kalmomin da ke da 'ing'. Don nuna matsala a matsayin mai zurfai, ana yin amfani da kalmomin kamar 'I see your point, but...' ko 'I'm afraid that...'. A nishadi da sharuwa, ana yin amfani da wasanni (If... then...). Yi tunani cewa a turanci, 'agree' yana da wata ma'ana ko 'yarda', ba wata kalma ce, saboda haka ba zaka yi 'I am agree' har 'I agree'.

concept_examples.text: I would suggest we postpone the deadline to next week.
concept_examples.translation: Na yiwu in aiki da sabuwar shekaru saboda sabuwar shekaru.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd səˈdʒɛst wi poʊstˈpoʊn ðə ˈdɛdlaɪn tu nɛkst wik/

concept_examples.text: We could consider a discount if you increase the order volume.
concept_examples.translation: Muna iya yin tunani game da sabuwar tashar da idan ku ke karɓa da yawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wi kʊd kənˈsɪdər ə ˈdɪskaʊnt ɪf ju ˈɪnkris ðə ˈɔrdər ˈvɑljum/

concept_examples.text: I'm afraid that price is a bit higher than we expected.
concept_examples.translation: Ina tsoron cewa wannan farashin ya fi wanda muna tsammanin.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæt praɪs ɪz ə bɪt ˈhaɪər ðæn wi ɪkˈspɛktɪd/

concept_examples.text: What if we split the difference and meet in the middle?
concept_examples.translation: Me yaushe idan muka rage farashin da ke dacewa?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf wi splɪt ðə ˈdɪfərəns ænd mit ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/

common_error.wrong: I am agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct: I agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct_alt: I completely agree with your proposal, but we would need a better price.
common_error.explanation: Anan an yi kuskure saboda a turanci muna yarda da 'estoy de acuerdo' (da yin amfani da 'estar' + sunan), saboda haka ya zama 'I am agree'. A turanci, 'agree' yana da wata ma'ana ko 'yarda', ba wata kalma ce, saboda haka ba zaka yi amfani da 'to be' da ita. Don wucewa da wannan kuskure, yarda cewa 'agree' yana da wata ma'ana ko 'yarda' amma ba tare da 'be'. Wani ne kuma muna yin amfani da adadun kamar 'completely' ko 'partially' don nuna fasaha.

examples.original: I would like to propose a different approach.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə prəˈpoʊz ə ˈdɪfərənt əˈproʊtʃ/
examples.translation: Na son yin shawara saboda wata sabuwa hanya.
examples.note: Yin amfani da 'would like to' don zama mai zurfai da fasaha, ya fi 'quisiera' a turanci amma ba tare da tsagin wasanni.

examples.original: How about meeting next Tuesday?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt ˈmitɪŋ nɛkst ˈtuzdeɪ/
examples.translation: Me yaushe idan muka yi taron da sabuwar ranar Talata?
examples.note: 'How about' da sauran kalmomin da ke da 'ing' wata hanya ce ta yin shawara. Ba a yi fasalin da yake a turanci ba.

examples.original: I suggest we revisit the terms of the contract.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ səˈdʒɛst wi riˈvɪzɪt ðə tɜrmz əv ðə ˈkɑntrækt/
examples.translation: Na shawara mu bincika waɗannan sharuwar da ke cikin takardar siyasa.
examples.note: A turanci, bayan 'suggest' ana yin amfani da tsagin wasanni (ba tare da 's' a wata matsayi na uku), ya fi tsagin wasanni a turanci.

levels.label: Expressing Disagreement Diplomatically
levels.translation: Nuna matsala a matsayin mai zurfai

examples.original: I see your point, but I have some concerns about the timeline.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ si jʊr pɔɪnt bʌt aɪ hæv sʌm kənˈsɜrnz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈtaɪmlaɪn/
examples.translation: Na gane matsayinka amma ina da wasu matsaloli game da sabuwar shekaru.
examples.note: Wannan tsarin yana zurfai da matsala bayan gane matsayin wani.

examples.original: I'm afraid that's not quite what we had in mind.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæts nɑt kwaɪt wʌt wi hæd ɪn maɪnd/
examples.translation: Ina tsoron cewa ba wata abu ne da muna tsammanin.
examples.note: 'I'm afraid' ba yana nuna tsoro ba har ma kuskuren mai zurfai ne. Wata kalma mai fa'ida ce.

examples.original: I understand your position, but we would need more flexibility.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd jʊr pəˈzɪʃən bʌt wi wʊd nid mɔr ˌflɛksəˈbɪlɪti/
examples.translation: Na gane matsayinka amma muna bukata da sabuwa zurfai.
examples.note: Yin amfani da 'would need' a matsayin 'need' don zama mai zurfai da zurfai.

levels.label: Negotiating Terms and Closing Deals
levels.translation: Nishadi da sharuwa da kiyaye sharuwa

examples.original: If you can offer a 10% discount, we would be willing to sign today.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju kæn ˈɔfər ə tɛn pɜrˈsɛnt ˈdɪskaʊnt wi wʊd bi ˈwɪlɪŋ tə saɪn təˈdeɪ/
examples.translation: Idan ku iya ba da 10% na rashin farashin, za mu yarda da rubuta yau.
examples.note: Tsagin da ke da 'if' + 'would' don samun wata ba da shawara.

examples.original: Let's meet halfway on the shipping costs.
examples.phonetic: /lɛts mit ˈhæfweɪ ɒn ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ kɔsts/
examples.translation: Za mu rage farashin da ke cikin sabis na sabuntawa.
examples.note: 'Meet halfway' wata kalma ce ta nuna wata shawara ta rage farashin.

examples.original: We have a deal if you agree to these terms.
examples.phonetic: /wi hæv ə dil ɪf ju əˈgri tə ðiz tɜrmz/
examples.translation: Muna da shawara idan ku yarda da wannan sharuwa.
examples.note: Ana yin amfani da 'a deal' a matsayin 'an agreement' a cikin hanyoyin nishadi na fasaha.

title: Discussing Literature and Film / Magana da adadin da fasaha
bridge: A cikin Ingilishi, don nuna muna da ra'ayoyi game da littafai da fasaha, ana yin amfani da tsarin kamar 'I found it...' ko 'It struck me as...', wanda ba da wani daidaitaccen sauyawa a cikin Hausa, inda muna da yawa mu yi amfani da 'me pareció' ko 'me resultó'. Kuma, masu bayyana ra'ayi a cikin Ingilishi na iya zama a gaba da suna (a gripping novel), while a cikin Hausa na iya zama bayan suna (wata littafa mai haske). Wani matsalar da ke da kama da fasaha da ra'ayi shine yin amfani da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha. A cikin Ingilishi, an yi amfani da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha.
rule: Don nuna muna da ra'ayoyi game da littafai da fasaha a matanin B2, ya kamata ka sami: 1) Nuna ra'ayoyi da masu bayyana ra'ayi da tsarin kamar 'I found it + adjective' (I found it thought-provoking) ko 'It struck me as + adjective' (It struck me as predictable). 2) Nuna fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha (The story follows a detective who uncovers a conspiracy). 3) Yin amfani da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha (I read the book last year). 4) Nuna fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha (Unlike the book, the film omits several key scenes). Kuma ya kamata ka yi amfani da 'based on' (The movie is based on a novel). Wajen kalmomin, masu bayyana ra'ayi kamar 'gripping', 'thought-provoking', 'predictable', 'far-fetched', 'moving' su ne matsaloli masu muhimmanci. Kada ka yi fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha.

concept_examples.text: I found the novel gripping from the first page.
concept_examples.translation: Na sami wannan littafa mai haske daga farko da sabuwar fasaha.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ðə ˈnɒvəl ˈɡrɪpɪŋ frəm ðə fɜːst peɪdʒ.

concept_examples.text: The film is based on a true story.
concept_examples.translation: Wannan fasaha ta dogara ne akan wata tarihin gaskiya.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə fɪlm ɪz beɪst ɒn ə truː ˈstɔːri.

concept_examples.text: Unlike the book, the movie has a much faster pace.
concept_examples.translation: A karshe, fasahar da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha.
concept_examples.phonetic: ʌnˈlaɪk ðə bʊk, ðə ˈmuːvi hæz ə mʌtʃ ˈfɑːstə peɪs.

concept_examples.text: The author uses symbolism to explore themes of identity.
concept_examples.translation: Yau da yau, mabuta yana yin amfani da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha.
concept_examples.phonetic: ði ˈɔːθə juːzɪz ˈsɪmbəlɪzəm tuː ɪkˈsplɔː θiːmz ɒv aɪˈdentɪti.

common_error.wrong: The book is more interesting that the movie.
common_error.correct: The book is more interesting than the movie.
common_error.correct_alt: The book is more interesting compared to the movie.
common_error.explanation: A cikin Ingilishi, don nuna fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fas

examples.original: I found the ending a bit predictable.
examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ði ˈendɪŋ ə bɪt prɪˈdɪktəbəl.
examples.translation: Na sami wannan fasaha mai haske.
examples.note: Muna yin amfani da 'I found + object + adjective' don nuna ra'ayi. Wannan ya fi natural da 'I think it was'.

examples.original: It struck me as a very thought-provoking film.
examples.phonetic: ɪt strʌk mi æz ə ˈveri ˈθɔːt prəˈvəʊkɪŋ fɪlm.
examples.translation: Wannan fasaha ta samu muku da fasaha.
examples.note: 'It struck me as' wata harshe ce don nuna muna da fasaha da fasaha.

examples.original: The dialogue felt really natural.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈdaɪəlɒɡ fɛlt ˈrɪəli ˈnætʃrəl.
examples.translation: Yau da yau, fasahar da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha.
examples.note: Se usa 'feel' para hablar de percepciones subjetivas.

examples.original: The story follows a young detective who uncovers a conspiracy.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstɔːri ˈfɒləʊz ə jʌŋ dɪˈtɛktɪv huː ʌnˈkʌvəz ə kənˈspɪrəsi.
examples.translation: Wata fasaha ta nuna mabuta mai fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha.
examples.note: Muna yin amfani da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha.

examples.original: In the end, the protagonist realizes the truth.
examples.phonetic: ɪn ði end, ðə prəˈtæɡənɪst ˈrɪəlaɪzɪz ðə truːθ.
examples.translation: A karshe, mabutan ya samu fasaha.
examples.note: Muna yin amfani da 'in the end' ko 'at the end' don nuna fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fas

examples.original: The plot twists unexpectedly when the villain is revealed.
examples.phonetic: ðə plɒt twɪsts ʌnɪkˈspɛktɪdli wɛn ðə ˈvɪlən ɪz rɪˈviːld.
examples.translation: Fasahar ta samu fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fas
examples.note: El presente simple es perfecto para describir giros argumentales.

examples.original: Whereas the book is very descriptive, the film relies on visual storytelling.
examples.phonetic: ˌweərˈæz ðə bʊk ɪz ˈveri dɪˈskrɪptɪv, ðə fɪlm rɪˈlaɪz ɒn ˈvɪʒuəl ˈstɔːritəlɪŋ.
examples.translation: Mientras que el libro es muy descriptivo, la película se apoya en la narración visual.
examples.note: Usa 'whereas' para contrastar dos ideas. En español sería 'mientras que'.

examples.original: The movie adaptation leaves out a lot of the subplots.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈmuːvi ˌædæpˈteɪʃən liːvz aʊt ə lɒt ɒv ðə ˈsʌbplɒts.
examples.translation: La adaptación cinematográfica omite muchos de los subtramas.
examples.note: 'Leave out' significa omitir. Es común en críticas de adaptaciones.

examples.original: Unlike the original, the remake has a more optimistic ending.
examples.phonetic: ʌnˈlaɪk ði əˈrɪdʒɪnəl, ðə ˈriːmeɪk hæz ə mɔːr ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk ˈendɪŋ.
examples.translation: A diferencia del original, el remake tiene un final más optimista.
examples.note: Usa 'unlike' al principio de la frase para contrastar.
